slope-field-solutions.alt: The slope field of dy/dx = (3 − y)/2 drawn every half unit. The dashed green line y = 3 has slope 0 everywhere. A crimson curve through (0, 1) rises and flattens toward y = 3; a blue curve through (0, 5.5) falls and flattens toward y = 3. Neither crosses the line.
